Poison |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]8 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]2 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]14 |hidden = N/A |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Level 2+}} |flying = N/A }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Deals single target poison dps.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Ivy''' is a unit spawned by the [[Biologist]]. The [[Biologist]] is able to spawn the '''Ivy''' starting from Level 1, as long as it selected in the unit queue. It spawns on ground within the [[Biologist]]'s range. The '''Ivy's''' statistics improve as the [[Biologist]] is upgraded. The '''Ivy''' fires out a projectile at enemies which damages and poisons any enemy hit. This projectile deals energy damage and is also explosive, meaning that it can damage multiple enemies at once. Poisoned enemies will receive damage over time and will additionally get slowed down. This slowdown gets stronger with levels. Its poison effect cannot stack with poison from other sources, such as the [[Toxic Gunner]]. ==Appearance== The '''Ivy''' is a poisonous and closed flower which fires out toxic projectiles at enemies. It is purple and green. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $PDPS$ = Poison Damage / Poison Tick $CDPS$ = $DPS$ + $PDPS$ $MDPS$ = $DPS$ * Unit Queue $MPDPS$ = $PDPS$ * Unit Queue $MCDPS$ = ($DPS$ + $PDPS$) * Unit Queue $TED$ = Poison Damage * (Poison Time / Poison Tick) $MREF$ = DPS is multiplied by the '''Biologist's''' unit queues. $IREF$ = DPS is multiplied by the '''Biologist's''' unit queues. As poison can only be applied to an enemy once, poison DPS will only be accounted for once. $TREF$ = Total Elapsed Damage is calculated as Poison Damage × (Poison Time ÷ Poison Tick).

}} ==Strategy== *It is best to use the '''Ivy''' when there are large swarms of enemies, this lets it deal the most DPS possible. **Pairing it with support towers such as the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Cryomancer]] can give the '''Ivy''' more time to deal damage. *Despite its description saying that it deals single target DPS, the '''Ivy''' instead deals splash damage. **It also has worse range and DPS compared to the [[Sunflower]] or [[Nightshade (Unit)|Nightshade]] making it much worse for single target. *The '''Ivy''' can be pretty effective against hordes of enemies, as its explosion deals full damage to all enemies hit by it. **However, it does not bypass defense, as its explosion deals energy damage rather than explosion damage. *Explosions from the '''Ivy''' apply poison to enemies, which deals damage over time and slows them down slightly. **This effect cannot stack with poison from other sources, such as the [[Toxic Gunner]]. If both are applied at the same time, [[Toxic Gunner]]'s poison will take priority. *Both its explosion and poison can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, making the '''Ivy''' useful at clearing them out. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{WeaponHeader|All skins}}{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- |[[File:DefaultIvyFire.ogg]] |Firing sound |- |[[File:DefaultIvyExplosion.ogg]] |Explosion sound |}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|Default skin on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IvyIconIG.png|In-game icon. }} ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Ivy''' added. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Firerate decreased due to the [[Firerate Bug]] getting fixed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Firerate decreased from 2.025 to 2. ***'''Level 1''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.825 to 1.8. ***'''Level 2''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.825 to 1.8. ***'''Level 3''' ****Firerate decreased from 1.525 to 1.5. ==References== {{TowerNavBox}}
